  - paragraph: "Objective: Infer a consistent rule from rows and columns and complete missing table entries."

  - text: "1"
  - heading "Explore & complete the table" [level=2]
  - paragraph: Use the rules and relationships to infer the rule. Fill the three blanks so the rule holds for every row.
  - article:
    - heading "INPUTS OUTPUT" [level=3]
    - table:
      - rowgroup:
        - row "a b output":
          - columnheader
          - columnheader "a"
          - columnheader "b"
          - columnheader "output"
      - rowgroup:
        - row "Row 1 1 2 4":
          - rowheader "Row 1"
          - cell "1"
          - cell "2"
          - cell "4"
        - row "Row 2 3 4 10":
          - rowheader "Row 2"
          - cell "3"
          - cell "4"
          - cell "10"
        - row "Row 3 5 7 17":
          - rowheader "Row 3"
          - cell "5"
          - cell "7"
          - cell "17":
            - spinbutton "Row 3 output": "17"
    - paragraph: All values are integers.
  - article:
    - text: "2"
    - heading "Build your rule" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Combine the inputs a and b to get the output.
    - button "a"
    - button "b"
    - button "2a"
    - button "2b"
    - button "a + b"
    - button "a - b"
    - button "2a + b"
    - button "a + 2b"
    - button "3a"
    - button "b - a"
    - text: Your rule
    - status "Your rule": output = 2a + b
  - text: "3"
  - heading "Relationships at a glance" [level=2]
  - article:
    - heading "Row relationship" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Across each row, output depends on a and b.
    - text: a b
    - strong: output
  - article:
    - heading "Column patterns" [level=3]
    - paragraph: As a increases, generated output changes by the selected rule.
    - strong: 4 to 10 to 17
  - article:
    - heading "Rule preview" [level=3]
    - paragraph: If output = 2a + b, then a=3, b=4 gives 10.
  - button "Test all rows":
    - img
    - text: Test all rows
  - button "Reset":
    - img
    - text: Reset
  - text: Holds for all rows Fitted to one row Contradiction
  - img
  - heading "Rule holds for all rows!" [level=2]
  - paragraph: All rows are consistent with output = 2a + b.
  - table:
    - rowgroup:
      - row "Row 1 Row 2 Row 3":
        - columnheader "Row 1"
        - columnheader "Row 2"
        - columnheader "Row 3"
      - row "OK OK OK":
        - cell "OK"
        - cell "OK"
        - cell "OK"
  - article:
    - heading "Why it works" [level=2]
    - paragraph: The rule output = 2a + b creates a consistent pattern across every row.
    - paragraph: When a increases, output increases twice as much.
    - paragraph: When b increases, output increases the same amount.
  - article:
    - heading "Worked example" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Use output = 2a + b.
    - paragraph: "Row 3: a=5, b=7"
    - strong: 2 x 5 + 7 = 17
  - article:
    - heading "Common misconception" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Trying to fit a rule using only one row.
    - paragraph: A wrong rule may work once but fail on Row 2. Always test every row.
  - heading "Mini challenge" [level=2]
  - paragraph: Which rule completes the table for all rows?
  - table:
    - rowgroup:
      - row "Row a b output":
        - columnheader "Row"

        - cell "7"
        - cell "?"
